title: Verify text-search semantics in the existing Open Food Facts SDK fix
problem: The README text_search example is reported to fail after CGI authentication changes. Existing PR #504 substitutes /api/v2/search while retaining search_terms, but official v2 docs say full-text search is unsupported. Its changed tests mock fixed results and cannot establish server search semantics.
humanitarian_relevance: Correct product retrieval supports open food-information tools and research. This is a public-benefit pathway, not a demonstrated health or humanitarian-outcome improvement.

evidence.claim: Issue #496 reports HTTP 503 from the documented text_search example; a maintainer says the CGI endpoint now requires authentication.

Read both changed-file diffs at PR head 970a7290a8a5869de8f5784324c166212fdd15ca: the method changes to /api/v2/search and retains search_terms; the tests change URL mocks and return predetermined products. No target test was run.
Current official v2 search documentation explicitly states that full-text requests are unsupported. This is documented contract evidence, not a live query result.

38 unchanged SDK API tests pass with blocked Python socket/DNS operations. Four cases executing the pinned original server filter verify that search_terms is removed before query construction, with structured-filter and pagination controls. Source dispatch was traced but full HTTP/server/database execution did not occur.
Verification note delivered as humanifest-bot at 2026-09-09T07:30:38Z. A separate GitHub API read verified exact author and body. Delivery is not maintainer confirmation or acceptance.

code_surface: src/openfoodfacts/api.py ProductResource.text_search and tests/unit/test_api.py in existing PR #504 at 970a7290a8a5869de8f5784324c166212fdd15ca. Server at 3a97b98032d27b7a5e33de0c2edcde0c21ddf4c3: Routing.pm, cgi/display.pl and Display.pm search parameter filter.
proposed_change: First verify the documented mismatch and support the existing author with a semantic regression strategy. Agree the supported search/authentication and compatibility contract before changing the SDK. No replacement PR or credential-in-URL workaround.
tests: 38 unchanged SDK API tests pass on the pinned PR in a frozen wheel-only Python 3.11.10 environment with Python socket/DNS blocking. Four hash-checked cases execute the original server parameter filter: ordinary text, a nonce and no text forward identical empty filters; a structured-brand control survives, pagination/sorting are retained and owner filtering is invoked. No full server, live API, database or deployed-result test ran. Reusable fixtures and exact limits are in research/2026-09-09-openfoodfacts-runtime-verification.md.
environment: Disposable pinned PR checkout outside Humanifest. Existing Python 3.11.10/uv 0.8.22 installed 43 frozen core/development wheel dependencies with source builds, project install and automatic Python downloads disabled. No ML/Pillow/Redis extras or services needed for the focused API file. CI uses a different uv version and Linux/all-extras; this is not exact full CI replication. Original server filter runs with system Perl 5.34.1 and request/downstream-query spies. No credentials or live service calls.
maintainer: Existing PR author arybhatt4533. Verified findings were posted on PR #504 as humanifest-bot at 2026-09-09T07:30:38Z. Await the existing author/maintainers on the intended full-text/authentication contract and support scope; no replacement patch. Manual status review September 15 unless new input arrives.

Authentication and response compatibility require an agreed contract. Preserve the existing author; no screenshot/video proof, independent human review, bot-identity acceptance or deployment benefit is claimed.
